thread:
alex: Heads up — customer hit an odd routing case. They should've matched /v1/priority -> `priority-route`, but decision logs show `default-route` fallback.
alex: Pasted the sampled decision log we got (sanitized):
```json
{
  "request_id": "req_01Hxyz",
  "path": "/v1/priority/tasks",
  "headers": {
    "x-request-id": "req_01Hxyz",
    "x-customer-tier": "Gold"
  },
  "evaluations": [
    {
      "rule_id": "r-100-priority-path",
      "match": true
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "r-110-header-tier",
      "match": false,
      "reason": "header value mismatch (expected 'gold' exact)"
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "r-900-default",
      "match": true
    }
  ],
  "selected_route": "default-route"
}
```
alex: Note the header is `Gold` (capital G) and our header-match rule expects `gold` literal. We're sampling these logs at 0.1% so reproducing is flaky.
mira: Can you also paste the rule config? suspect header compare is case-sensitive. quick example of config we use for header match?
alex: Rule snippet from config (again sanitized):
```yaml
- rule_id: r-110-header-tier
  match:
    headers:
      x-customer-tier: 
        equals: "gold"
        # no flags for case-insensitive currently
  route: priority-route
```
mira: Yep, equals implies exact string match. Gateway currently preserves header values as-is and comparison is case-sensitive. Two options: normalize header values before matching OR support case-insensitive comparator like `equals_insensitive`.
ben: From an observability POV we should:
- add an evaluation trace artifact to spans (op: route.eval) that contains ordered rule decisions (compact proto)
- emit a boolean metric `route_eval_mismatch_total{route_expected,route_selected,rule_id}` when a path-match exists but header/misc rule misfires
- expose a sampled response header `X-Route-Eval-Trace: <short-id>` that can be used to fetch full trace in Console -> Routing -> Decision traces
ben: This lets support reproduce without over-indexing traces or logging tons of full request bodies.
alex: I can prototype `X-Route-Eval-Trace` quickly. Proposal: sample 1% of requests with trace header + store compact decision proto in trace store for 7 days. Start with 1% -> 10% on anomalies.
mira: For correctness I'd prefer changing matching logic too. We should treat header comparisons as configurable: `equals`, `equals_insensitive`, `regex`. Backwards compatible default stays `equals` to avoid silent semantics changes.
alex: Agreed. I'll implement normalization + an explicit `flags: [case_insensitive]` option in rule DSL. PR will include unit tests for header values with mixed case.
infra-bot: CI report: route-eval-proto-tests passed on linux-build-3.
ben: Also add a console card that shows recent mismatches for a rule with links to decision traces. That will help product & support triage.
alex: Quick curl to reproduce locally: 
```bash
curl -v -H "x-customer-tier: Gold" \ 
  -H "x-request-id: local-1" \ 
  https://api.internal.redwood/v1/priority/tasks
```
Expect currently: 200 from default-route payload which is confusing. After change expect 200 from priority-route.
mira: Small privacy note: decision traces must scrub any PII from headers/bodies before storing. Keep only header keys + truncated values (or hash) when configured.
ben: Agreed. We'll add a config toggle in telemetry: `store_decision_trace: none | metadata | full` and default to `metadata` (keys + hashed values) for hosted customers.
alex: Plan: I'll open 2 PRs — 1) gateway: header compare flags + normalization + tests; 2) obs: span field + minimal API to fetch decision trace by id + console card skeleton. Start sampling at 1%. PRs will reference this thread and include rollout notes and cost estimate.
:thumbsup:
mira: sgtm, thanks.
ben: sgtm, please include metric names and retention numbers in PR desc.
alex: will do, filing PRs now. :rocket:
